_schema: Per parent-vs-modified contrast. Loader produces a standardized long-format table (transcript_id, arm, log2FoldChange, seed_matched, ...). Every biological value (seed, dose) carries a source/VERIFY note. processed_status=on_disk loads directly; needs_preprocessing RAISES with the exact processed files that Prompt 2 must produce (loader never runs alignment).

contrasts.name: GSE108823_siRNA5_vs_siRNA5_GNA
contrasts.series_ref: Janas et al. 2018 (rat hepatocytes GalNAc-siRNA); treatment field labels -GNA and -iB modifications directly
contrasts.guide: siRNA-5 (targets Hao1; Janas et al. 2018 Nat Commun, DOI 10.1038/s41467-018-02989-4)

seed.source: PUBLISHED SEQUENCE: Schlegel et al. 2022 NAR (DOI 10.1093/nar/gkac539) Supplementary Table S1, Hao1 duplex D6 (parent) / D9 (GNA @ g7), guide strand 5'-UUGUCGAUGACUUUCACAUUCUG-3', seed g2-8 = UGUCGAU. This is a published sequence table, NOT enrichment-inferred. IDENTITY of NAR Hao1 D6/D9 to GSE108823 'siRNA-5' is a sourced inference (Janas 2018 states siRNA-4=Ttr, siRNA-5=Hao1; NAR D1=Ttr/D6=Hao1; both use GNA@g7), corroborated NON-circularly: Janas siRNA-4 reproduces the Ttr seed UAUAGAG signature at D=0.124 p=1.6e-27 (matching GSE184929 Ttr), confirming the Janas<->NAR compound-code mapping. CAVEAT: no single source literally equates 'siRNA-5' to this exact sequence; GEO/SRA carry no sequences, Janas 2018 supplementary is histology-only, Alnylam HAO1 patent full sequence listings were not machine-accessible (inconclusive), lumasiran is a different (3'UTR-targeting) siRNA. The Hao1 enrichment (D=0.158) is CONSISTENCY, not the seed's source, and random-7mer controls are not clean nulls (D up to 0.051, p to 5e-8; UGUCGAU is a ~3x outlier).

modification.source: Janas 2018 main text: a thermally destabilizing GNA nucleotide was placed at position seven of the antisense strand in siRNA-5 (same modification and position as GSE184929 D4).

dose.source: VERIFY: transfection dose not in the treatment field; requires Janas 2018 (methods list 10 nM transfections)

contrasts.assignment_note: Both arms are the SAME guide (siRNA-5, anti-Hao1): Hao1 on-target knocked down equally in parent (-1.55) and GNA (-1.61); parent off-targets (Cdh17,Actg1,Neo1,Sf3b1) collapse in the GNA arm. Per-group DESeq2 tables (siRNA-5.vsMock, siRNA-5-GNA.vsMock) downloaded from GEO on 2026-07-11. Data blocker RESOLVED; the certified-direction test remains BLOCKED on the unavailable siRNA-5 antisense seed.

on_target.source: Janas 2018 main text (siRNA-5 targets Hao1); confirmed in data: Hao1 knocked down equally in both arms (-1.55 parent, -1.61 GNA)

modification.source: VERIFY: arm Ttr-MOP is single alkyl phosphonate in the seed per GEO treatment label and series title; exact seed position requires Nikan 2025

dose.source: VERIFY: dose per arm not in the treatment field; titles show mg/kg dose groups; requires Nikan 2025

contrasts.assignment_note: Parent-vs-modified is metadata-labeled (Ttr-Parent vs Ttr-MOP). GEO provides only per-sample salmon quant.sf.gz (3' QuantSeq); Prompt 2 must run DESeq2 (or equivalent) to produce arm-vs-control log2FoldChange tables. A mouse 3'UTR fasta is also required and is not on disk. Loader does not run alignment.
